project.description: Searchable displayed column text and candidate order used by project queries.

placementOptions.description: Local media and linked-placement options consumed by compound sound edits.

importOptions.description: Local media import, analysis and label options consumed by import dispatch.

voiceoverOptions.description: Recording settings, input hardware and active take used by voice-over commands.

binNames.description: Distinct child-bin names used to choose an unused default bin name.

subclipOptions.description: Still-image duration and unit used for default subclip ranges.

itemIds.description: Ordered project item identities selected by Select All Project Items.

renameSelection.description: First timeline clip used by an implicit rename.

interpolationSelection.description: Timeline clips used by implicit time interpolation.

sequenceCount.description: Number of sequence items used by the unnamed new-sequence default.

processedBin.description: Identity of the first root bin named Processed Clips, or null.

metadataColumns.description: Canonical project metadata column names, excluding internal layout bookkeeping.

fontUses.description: Replace Fonts recipient and assignment facts indexed by canonical family and style.

entryOrder.description: Ordered direct item ids, independent of the items' content.

clipIds.description: Ordered sequence clip identities selected by Select All.

offlineEligible.description: Whether this source resolves to offline media for Edit Offline target selection.

audioClipIds.description: Ordered audio clip identities considered for ducking triggers, independent of empty lanes and clip names.

cameraMap.description: Effective ordered camera video/audio identities and enabled flags, independent of inferred or explicit representation and display names.

sourceStart.description: Source monitor lower bound used by navigation.

sourceEnd.description: Source monitor exclusive upper bound used by navigation.

sourceRate.description: Source monitor frame rate used by navigation.

sourceMarkIn.description: Source monitor In mark used by navigation.

sourceMarkOut.description: Source monitor Out mark used by navigation.

sourceMarkerStarts.description: Source marker destinations after filtering a subclip's range.

editPoints.description: Sorted unique sequence clip edges used by edit-point navigation.

mixerRoutes.description: Pairwise eligibility for a strip to feed a named submix; bounded to mixers with at most 64 ordinary strips, null beyond that cap.

metadataVideoReadOnly.description: Whether Video Info and Color Space are read-only metadata for this item.

metadataVideoCodecReadOnly.description: Whether Video Codec is read-only metadata for this item.

metadataAudioReadOnly.description: Whether Audio Info and Audio Codec are read-only metadata for this item.

metadataMarksReadOnly.description: Whether both ordinary marks exist, making In Point and Out Point read-only metadata.

parentBin.description: First containing bin used as the merged clip destination, or null.

projectOrder.description: Index of this item in the bins' depth-first order, which Automate to Sequence's sort ordering reads, independent of the items' content.

sourceGraphic.description: This source item's shared graphic definition and sorted recipient clip identities.

sourceGraphicDefinition.description: Shared layers and graphic metadata copied into a newly placed video clip, without recipient identities.

sourceAudioPlacement.description: Effective audio stream/channel placements computed by the shared command planner, empty for silent media and null for nonmedia.

newSequenceVideoMaterial.description: Copied video clip and transition identities by nonempty lane over a new sequence source’s full duration, independent of monitor marks.

newSequenceAudioMaterial.description: Copied audio clip and transition identities by nonempty lane over a new sequence source’s full duration, independent of monitor marks.

sourceHasAudio.description: Whether a sequence source has any audio track (nest placement capability).

sourceVideoMaterial.description: Copied video clip and transition identities by nonempty Source lane in its actual marked/split copy range.

sourceAudioMaterial.description: Copied audio clip and transition identities by nonempty Source lane in its actual marked/split copy range.

allJoinPlan.description: Survivors, removed pieces and affected transition identities of every unlocked through join.

captionTrackOrder.description: Ordered caption track identities, without descendant caption content.

captionTrackCount.description: Number of caption tracks used by the ordinal returned for a newly appended track.

videoTrackOrder.description: Ordered video track identities, without audio tracks or descendant content.

videoTrackNames.description: Outside name assignments to video lanes observed at the checkpoint.

audioTrackNames.description: Outside name assignments to audio lanes observed at the checkpoint.

submixTrackNames.description: Outside name assignments to submix lanes observed at the checkpoint.

audioTrackOrder.description: Ordered audio track identities, without video tracks or descendant content.

submixTrackOrder.description: Ordered submix track identities, without other tracks or descendant content.

markedMaterial.description: Track and clip identities intersecting stored inclusive In/Out marks, excluding empty tracks.

markedCaptionMaterial.description: Caption identities consumed by Extract's stored marked range.

motionScale.description: Video clip Motion parameters and refit switches consumed by proportional frame-size scaling.

submixDependants.description: Strip identities and send positions that a submix deletion reroutes or removes.

joinLock.description: Lock eligibility used by historical through-join membership.

nextVideoTrack.description: Identity of this video track’s next video sibling, or null; independent of tracks before it and clip content.

nextAudioTrack.description: Identity of this audio track’s next audio sibling, or null; independent of tracks before it and clip content.

clipOrder.description: Ordered direct clip ids, without descendant content.

editEdges.description: Ordered clip identities, starts and durations searched by geometry edits, without appearance.

editPoints.description: Sorted unique track clip edges used by targeted edit-point navigation.

joinInput.description: Bounded predicate values and owner used to reconstruct historical through-join recipients.

assignedStart.description: Start assigned by a command, held as content for same-field protection.

singleJoinPlan.description: Survivor, removed pieces and affected transition identities for a single named through join.

linkedGroup.description: Least recipient clip id representing this clip's linked group, or null.

linkedMembers.description: Sorted recipient ids on the group's least clip id; null on other clips.

assignedStart.description: Start assigned by a command, held as content for same-field protection.
